about: The TEST.no-test-hooks vocabulary every adapter reads (pytest, go, bun_test and vitest). fragments are regular expressions: the environment variable names, the values and the runner modules that mark a test run, and the JavaScript environment objects. A pattern file splices one in by writing its name between percent signs (%marker_name%). hook_phrases are the word pairs a production declaration ends with when it names a test-only hook (resetForTests, TEST_MODE), after the one identifier tokeniser (foundation/source/names.words) splits the name at underscores, digits and case changes.
